How to Find a Tax Accountant Near Me?

If tax season has you stressed, or you're running a business and need help keeping the numbers straight, finding the right CPA or tax accountant nearby can make life a whole lot easier. A good one won't just file your return — they'll look out for you all year, help you avoid costly mistakes, and find ways to save you money.

Here's how to start your search:

Check professional lists. Sites like the American Institute of CPAs (AICPA) directory, your state CPA society, or even Thumbtack can help you find licensed pros close by.

Ask around. Friends, family, coworkers, or other business owners can be your best source for recommendations — especially if they've been with their CPA for years.

Google it — but dig deeper. Search for "CPA near me", "tax accountant near me", "tax advisor near me" or "tax accountants near me". Don't just stop at the first result — check reviews, look at recent comments, and see if people mention good communication and accuracy.

Make sure they're legit. They should be licensed in your state and have experience with your specific needs, whether that's small business accounting, freelance taxes, or dealing with IRS letters.

Know what they do (and don't do). Some focus only on tax prep, while others offer bookkeeping, payroll, and year-round planning. Pick someone who can handle what you actually need.

Be clear on costs. Ask if they charge a flat fee, hourly, or per form. Surprises are fine for birthdays — not for billing.

Meet before you decide. A quick consultation can tell you if they explain things clearly, listen to your concerns, and make you feel confident they've got your back.
